items.prompt: A column batch has one shared row identity. Which operation preserves it when filtering?

options.text: Filter each column independently by its own values
options.why: Different selections can pair unrelated fields.

options.text: Use one shared row selection for every column
options.why: The retained positions continue to describe the same records.

options.text: Sort only quantities while leaving prices fixed
options.why: That can change the pairings without a shape error.

options.text: Drop all identity columns before checking alignment
options.why: That discards evidence needed to verify the correspondence.

items.explanation: One common selection or permutation preserves field correspondence. Equal lengths alone do not establish correct pairing.
